global_reduction.claim: N3(tau,C0) for one fixed tau implies full QFORM; this run takes tau=1/64

new_results.statement: For A=RMR^T, R^TR=I3, s_min(M)>=1, physical row h with r=r_h, c=||r||^2 and a=A_hh: sum_{j!=h} A_hj^2 = ||Mr||^2-a^2 >= c-a^2. Thus c>1/2 and |a|<1/64 imply star energy >2047/4096.

If additionally some |A_hj|>=1/16 with both diagonals <1/64, the physical pair is indefinite with |det B|>15/4096 and sigma_min(B)>3/64, so the arbitrary-rank pair theorem gives density <239. Otherwise the star splits into three disjoint original leaf banks of energy >=1/8 each.

An explicit exact-rank-three N3(1/64) Parseval-frame family has spectrum {1,1,-1}, packet directional masses (1/4,1/4,1), a leverage-127/128 singleton near-coloop and genuinely mixed residual rows, but zero cross-packet third-volume because the first two packet ranges coincide.

The stress family has Q=U^2+2WZ on disjoint original banks, U independent of (W,Z), ||p_U||inf<=sqrt(2), and orthonormal W,Z coefficient vectors. Rank-two affine half-Riesz gives sup_t E|2WZ-t|^-1/2<=128, hence ||p_Q||inf<=128sqrt(2)<181.020.
